$comment: Canonical LOGICAL provider vocabulary, derived from the `provider:` field in
spec/metamodel/*.json -- the source of truth. This file is its machine-readable index,
and a lint asserts the two agree.
Conformance fixtures name LOGICAL ids. Each port maps them to its own PHYSICAL providers:
TypeScript/C#/Python map 1:1; Java splits one logical id across many SPI providers. That
asymmetry is deliberate -- physical packaging is idiomatic per ecosystem and is invisible
to expected-registry.json, which is provider-blind by design (ADR-0050).
declaresTypes: registers types (an OWN-attr home). projectsOnto: types owned by another
provider that this one decorates -- those attrs MUST be optional (ADR-0050). '*.*' is the
common-attr projection onto every type, the widest blast radius of all.
